module: Career mode telemetry tracker: measures how long a career is played (activity "careerActive" with the save state at opening: money, beamXP, vouchers, vehicle count, new save, tutorial) and records the vehicles bought (vehicleAddedToInventory) and sold (vehicleSold). It goes through telemetry_core.startActivity/endActivity/addEvent.
notes: Extension in manual unload; on a Lua reload, onExtensionUnloaded closes the activity in progress (otherwise it would have no duration).
onBeforeVehicleSell does nothing if the inventory does not contain inventoryId.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when the career becomes active or inactive: starts or ends the careerActive activity (with the player's attributes at start).

active.desc: true if the career is starting.

newSave.desc: true if it is a new save.

onVehicleAddedToInventory.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is added to the inventory: records model, name and purchase price.

onBeforeVehicleSell.desc: Hook called before a vehicle is sold: records model, name and sale price.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: sets the extension to manual unload.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: a Lua reload destroys the trackers without onExit, so the career activity is also closed here.
